confidence_notes: Recent city price indexes serve as a proxy for July 2026 and vary widely for the three-course meal. Cocktail and wine estimates reflect their premiums over beer on a small sample of local menus. Lodging is modeled for July. [Numbeo](https://de.numbeo.com/lebenshaltungskosten/stadt/Udaipur), [Wise](https://wise.com/in/cost-of-living/india/udaipur), [Shamiana menu](https://www.shamianaudaipur.com/bar-menu/), [Qalaa menu](https://qalaaudaipur.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/menu-pdf-juno.pdf)
comparable_city_reasoning: Jaipur and Jodhpur provide a lodging baseline because they share Rajasthan's mix of heritage tourism, hostels, and budget guesthouses. The estimates allow for Udaipur's lakefront premium and July monsoon seasonality.
